examined.reason: Restricted actual fetched shared-memory barrier program now connects control history, completed results, finite existence and allocation safety; general collective coverage remains partial.
Reviewed exact Luna unary constructor, input-read metadata, evaluator and typed decoder extension. Old theorem statements are unchanged; limits and exact links refreshed.
Actual TorchLean tensor layout now connects the existing unsigned vector-add kernel to modular and no-overflow real results. General numerical and orchestration obligations remain separate.

Every archived trial is now hash-verified, including second-task failures, unchanged-v1/corrected-v2 evaluator and resumed usage; mutation demonstrates a compile-preserving metadata error is rejected.

Source and independent proof review accepted exact clz.b32/popc.b32 patch after two repairs, fresh replay and trace-metadata mutation. Architecture eligibility remains documented rather than generally checked.
Reachable-state invariants derive phase identity, arrival/store/load counts, completion-before-load and actual exit; no desired read values are premises.

Source identity yields partner value for arbitrary valid candidates; exact fields, counts and keyed trace subsequences connect every completed schedule. Fresh witness and stale-without-order distinction checked.
Actual emitted accesses imply general byte-range, alignment, initialization and CTA ownership checks; descriptor preserved across every finite trace.
Typed fixed program fetches shared stores/barrier/loads/exits; arbitrary-schedule frames/history, concrete finite run and exact event projection proved and independently reviewed.
Actual pinned TorchLean tensor views use bounded interleaved global storage. Modular result covers overflow; exact-real theorem retains input-only no-overflow condition and concrete counterexample.
Only common audit/import closure changed; original semantics, theorem statements and checks are preserved.
Full PTX and reusable network verification goals remain incomplete; no Gemma, hardware-conformance or general progress claim added.
Existing permitted-execution, source-fidelity and computing-model responsibilities still hold; new collective child supplies a restricted instance.
Source provenance, smaller-model handoff and independent semantic checking remain required. Two adaptive tasks are not a held-out productivity estimate.
Integer tensor layout does not implement PTX backward code or change mathematical derivative obligations.
No floating-point policy or accuracy theorem introduced; unsigned wraparound and exact integer-real embedding are explicitly distinguished.
One allocation and one CTA barrier do not implement runtime launch/lifetime or multi-kernel composition.
Existing topology/allocation conditions reused by an explicit shared-arena adapter; no physical-launch correspondence claimed.
Checker meanings unchanged; emitted shared accesses discharge those existing byte-bound and ownership conditions.
Existing graph unchanged; new one-CTA uniform shared specialization adds justified barrier edges through separate layer.
The existing conservative additional-order layer is instantiated without modifying its eight validity rules.
Structural order interface unchanged; actual instruction-origin obligation is now discharged for one program, not for arbitrary phases.
Existing protocol and reuse proof unchanged. New fixed-program wrapper executes one generation and preserves the distinction from general warp operational behavior.
Independent source/proof reviews and exact replay preserve proof-validity versus semantic-fidelity distinction.
Source-section inventory remains exact and not a complete form-support ledger; accepted selected forms do not promote entire sections.
Original accepted min/max semantics and archive unchanged; full combined checks preserve its results.
Examples still exercise reusable contracts and expose limitations; new restricted barrier and integer tensor examples do not implement Gemma or full numerical network verification.

Exact Luna bitcount patch passed fresh independent replay; trace-metadata-only mutant still builds/proves but fails exactly 2 oracle checks. Stratic validates. Logs: /tmp/ptxlean-shared-final-root.log, /tmp/ptxlean-shared-final-joint.log. Numerical-audit draft and unimported prerequisite audit artifacts excluded and do not affect checked closure.
